our_interpretation: Read in context, this predicts the survival of Chinese domestic cloud generative AI provision, rather than the survival of every individual company or model.
Restrictions on importing chips, accessing overseas compute, or selling abroad do not themselves establish cessation of service on China-based infrastructure.
The nuclear-war exception excludes a cause; it is not an antecedent requiring evidence that a particular US policy occurred.
criteria.support_condition: Chinese companies remain able to serve generative AI on China-based infrastructure despite US actions throughout the unlimited horizon. Finite observations cannot conclusively establish this.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A feasible US action short of full nuclear war causes Chinese domestic cloud generative AI provision to cease, with no remaining Chinese providers able to supply it on China-based infrastructure.
